messages.text:
The latest browser run likely reused the previous dev server, so it was testing stale CSS/components while reporting current test files.

I’m moving Playwright to a clean verification port and adding stricter pointer rules/scroll margins so the card controls remain clickable under the sticky filter bar on desktop and mobile.
